claims.text: Different kinds of offensive content include hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, toxic comments, and insults.
Offensive content can be categorized into targeted insults (TIN) and untargeted profanity (UNT).
Insults and threats can be directed at individuals or groups, often classified as hate speech.
